alert_summary.rule_name: Bulk export via COPY TO STDOUT

evidence.statement: SELECT payment_id, invoice_no, amount, bank_account_snapshot FROM payments
SELECT p.payment_id, p.bank_account_snapshot, v.legal_name, v.bank_account FROM payments p JOIN contracts c USING (contract_id) JOIN vendors v USING (vendor_id)
COPY (SELECT payment_id, invoice_no, amount, bank_account_snapshot FROM payments) TO STDOUT WITH CSV HEADER
